fallback.disclaimer: Generated only from the last {dayCount} days of recorded data. This is not a diagnosis or treatment advice.
fallback.abstain: Insufficient data across all three dimensions (medication, water, sleep) in the last {dayCount} days. No insight is generated. Please keep logging daily data.
fallback.summary_default: The last {dayCount} days of records were updated. You can keep strengthening the daily routine based on what is already logged.
fallback.summary_needs_attention: Medication completion was about {medicationValue}% over the last {dayCount} days and average water intake was about {waterValue}L, so a few basic habits are still worth tightening up.
fallback.summary_stable: Medication records looked fairly steady over the last {dayCount} days, and hydration also showed some continuity. Keeping the current rhythm is reasonable.
fallback.pattern_medication_good: Medication adherence stayed above {value}% for {trackedDays} days. Source: reminder plan.
fallback.pattern_medication_attention: Medication adherence was around {value}% across {trackedDays} days, below expected. Source: reminder plan.
fallback.pattern_hydration: Average water intake was about {value}L across {trackedDays} days. Source: daily water records.
fallback.action_hydration: Keep logging daily water intake to maintain hydration rhythm.
fallback.action_logging: Keep logging medication to maintain data continuity.

prompt.user_intro: Generate a brief {languageLabel} longitudinal health insight for the supplied JSON facts.
prompt.tone: Keep the tone calm, concrete, and non-diagnostic. Abstain when data is insufficient — do not generate generalized prose.
prompt.action_label_hint: The lowRiskAction label should stay close to "{actionLabel}".
